# Component: data-table

**Purpose:** a sortable table of records.
**State:** planned

The shared roster table. `planned` is outside the closed pair, so the entry
states neither that its code exists nor that it is waiting to be written — and
an entry whose lifecycle nothing states is a unit no run can place.

## API / Slots

| Prop / slot | What it carries |
|------|--------------------------|
| `rows` | the records to render |
